findings.text: follow-on: _review_refusal hand-writes the refusal text instead of driving require_* as the production gate composes it, so nothing ties the new regex to the sentence at reckon/crew/routing.py:2583-2584; a change to that wording would silently stop the remedy and leave every test green. The production message does currently quote the invocation in backticks (read at routing.py:2584), so the behaviour is correct today.

follow-on: a stamped launch refusal that names no session and quotes no command is still returned None and the run reads as 'waiting for a lane slot', so the goal's 'whatever text it carries' holds only for refusals that state a remedy; the PlanReviewMissingError raised for an unresolvable plan (routing.py:2546) and PlanVisibilityError are such refusals.
